title: AAC Persistence Transaction Plan 1
description: Defines the canonical AAC Persistence Transaction Plan schema and its serialized data contract.

FormatVersion.description: Version of the persisted or exchanged document format.

TransactionId.description: Stable identifier of the transaction associated with this AAC persistence transaction plan.

TransactionType.description: Specifies the transaction type for this AAC persistence transaction plan.

CreatedAt.description: Specifies the created at for this AAC persistence transaction plan.

ReadSet.description: Lists the read set associated with this AAC persistence transaction plan.

RecordId.description: Stable identifier of the record associated with this read set.

ExpectedRecordRevision.description: Record revision that must still be current for the requested mutation to succeed.

ExpectAbsent.description: Indicates whether expect absent applies to this read set.

WriteSet.description: Lists the write set associated with this AAC persistence transaction plan.

RecordId.description: Stable identifier of the record associated with this write set.

Operation.description: Specifies the operation for this write set.

TargetRecordRevision.description: Record revision expected after the planned write completes.

Metadata.description: Additional structured metadata associated with this write set.
Additional structured metadata associated with this AAC persistence transaction plan.
